hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *CLAUDE.md) echo '[hook] WARNING: every CLAUDE.md is a one-line @AGENTS.md shim. Put the content in the matching AGENTS.md instead (see adr/0001-agent-docs-structure.md).' ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *extensionSettings.js) echo '[hook] Settings changed. A setting must exist in all four places: DEFAULT_SETTINGS, normalizeSettings, options/optionsPage.html, and both functions in options/optionsPage.js. Use the add-setting skill.' ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *.js|*.json|*.md|*.css|*.html) npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *src/photosRpc/*|*src/locationState/*|*src/contentEntry.js|*src/googlePhotosPage.js) echo '[hook] Lookup or page logic changed. Run the validate agent before you open a PR.' ;; esac
